data.bug_class: heap-buffer-overflow (out-of-bounds read from config line buffer)
data.rationale: In the auth_opt_/plugin_opt_ option parsing branch, `key = mosquitto__strdup(&token[prefix_len])` duplicates the ENTIRE remainder of the line (not just the first token). The subsequent pointer arithmetic `token += prefix_len + strlen(key) + 1` therefore skips one byte past the line's NUL terminator whenever the token contains no space and strlen(token) >= prefix_len+3 (the length check at line 1051 is insufficient). token now points one past the end of the line, into the uninitialized tail of the 1000-byte heap buffer allocated in config__read_file (conf.c:2493). The loop at lines 1066-1068 reads token[0] and, since ASAN fills fresh malloc with 0xbe, the byte is nonzero; line 1078 then calls mosquitto__strdup(token), which reads past the end of the buffer, producing 'READ of size 988 at ... 0 bytes to the right of 1000-byte region' in config__read_file_core conf.c:1078. Reachable from LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput via broker_fuzz_test_config: config line 'plugin /x' sets cur_plugin (REQUIRE_PLUGIN satisfied; dlopen is skipped in fuzz build), then line 'auth_opt_abc' triggers the overshoot. Verified by running /out/broker_fuzz_test_config with that 2-line config.
